now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#4
now.text: Robbie Robertson is editor in chief of the Bugle, where Peter sells his photos, and one of the few there who sees Spider-Man as a hero.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A young photographer at Robbie's paper.

proposed.text: Robbie Robertson is an editor at the Bugle, where Peter sells his photos, and one of the few there who sees Spider-Man as a hero.

changes.evidence: In The Spectacular Spider-Man, J. Jonah Jameson is the Bugle's publisher and editor-in-chief; Robbie is his editor (Market Forces, #4, calls him assistant editor when Peter goes to replace his check). The text wrongly calls Robbie editor in chief.

now.title: Luke Cage S2#13
now.text: Mariah Dillard calls Rosalie Carbone and the other crime bosses to a meeting to work together. Once Mariah is arrested, Rosalie turns against her and moves in on Harlem.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A crime boss Mariah calls in to work together, who later turns on her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Harlem crime boss who calls Rosalie in to work together. Rosalie later turns on her.

proposed.text: Once Mariah is arrested, Rosalie turns against her and moves in on Harlem.

changes.evidence: The crime bosses' meeting Mariah calls happens in Luke Cage S2#12 (Can't Front on Me, already stage 0). In S2#13 (They Reminisce Over You) Mariah is in prison and Rosalie joins the war for Harlem, trying to take it for the Carbones. The stage's first sentence repeats a #12 event under the #13 title.
